other: His passive gives him additional {st:DianxueHongLu} application on clash win on top of his passive application on his last target every turn.
His passive gives him additional Offense Level and {st:Breath} generation when deployed with other Cinq identities in Backup or Support.
usage: Applies {st:DianxueHongLu} on enemies, giving him more power and coin reuses. The stack goes up every turn he hits the same target and expires if he applies it to a different target. It's replaced when someone else applies Nerve Strike, but retains its stacks allowing you to swap between Nerve Strikes.
Gains {st:Agility} based on his {st:Breath} and gains Coin Power when faster than his target.

passiveBonusNotes: Assumes max Nerve Strike and max Cinq allies.
